summary.text: Predeclared normal: trolley B4-B7 at 0-3, then consecutive hand trips B8-B12 at 3-8. Higher dose: same first trolley, singleton trolley B8 at 3-6, then consecutive hand trips B9-B12 at 6-10. Inspect each eligible next carrier immediately. Hypothesis: both complete twelve correct releases by 13, with eight versus ten occupied transfer minutes. Opposing prediction: at least one higher-dose success uses no more transfer minutes than its control.

Fix two independently reset matched normal/higher trial pairs at identical initial demand before observation. Exact metric: twelve correct releases by 13 outranks failure; among complete successes fewer occupied transfer minutes wins; failures against failures are unordered. Ledger records unload identities, releases, occupied intervals, rack occupancy, waits and charge. Switch only if BOTH higher-dose trials worsen this metric versus their controls. Otherwise hold normal; missing trials establish no trigger.

Declared exit without powered trolley: consecutive hand trips B4-B12 at 0-9, inspecting immediately throughout. Model prediction: twelve correct releases by 13, nine occupied transfer minutes, one more than normal. Separate clerks retain their roles. Defeat: either complete higher-dose trial ties or beats its control, or hand exit fails complete release. All schedules and outcomes are predictions, not observations.
